text:
ivy: quick question  for the RFC appendix: should we flip the default to opt-in for billing attrs in SDKs or keep global propagation but throttle at ingest?

mark: short answer: opt-in by default. long answer: global propagation makes debugging and billing easy but explodes cardinality. we paid for that last quarter.

sasha: opt-in forces teams to make a deliberate decision (good), but we need low-friction guardrails so people don't forget and lose attribution.

trent: +1. propose a hybrid: SDK emits `envelope.meta` and a `billing_intent` flag by default. exact values are only attached when service toggles `billing-authorized` or calls `attachBillingValues()`.

ivy: what about hosted vs private deployments? hosted probably needs stricter controls.

mark: for hosted, default to meta-only + hashed buckets for sampled traces. private deployments can opt into exact values with a config switch. the console should show which services have exact attribution.

sasha: also important: add lint checks in CI that warn when a repo calls attachBillingValues() but the service manifest lacks billing-authorized. avoids the common mistake.

trent: detection is key: create monitors that alert when attributed_pct drops > 7% vs baseline or when high-cost queries return "no billing_key" frequently.

infra-bot: note: canary of SDK v2 with envelope.meta-only enabled in staging (ci/2218) :white_check_mark:

ivy: rollout playbook idea: 1) change SDK default to meta+intent, 2) pilot with billing & cust-eng services, 3) expose console toggle and linter, 4) run a 4-week pilot and compare invoiced coverage.

mark: we should also provide a best-effort lookup during queries and a nightly backfill job. inferred attribution must be labeled `inferred_backfill:v1` and require approval before invoices use it.

sasha: privacy: require non-reversible hashing for any long-term retention of tenant identifiers, and keep exact values only for short TTL (7d) unless explicitly extended with approval.

trent: action items: mark -> draft appendix section with ingest delta estimates and tradeoffs (due Fri), sasha -> linter PR for instrumentation checks (due Wed), ivy -> pilot plan and monitoring thresholds (due Thu).

ivy: thanks all  I'll merge notes into the RFC follow-up and share links. :heart:
